# Scientific & Bioinformatics Projects

This section contains independent analyses and reproducible workflows based on publicly available scientific datasets.

## Current projects

### Ecogenomics and Comparative Genomics of Chroococcidiopsidales

**Project status:** Ongoing  
**Last update:** September 2026

Independent ecogenomics project integrating genome-quality assessment, genome-based taxonomy, phylogenomics, comparative genomics and environmental metadata to investigate genomic diversity across *Chroococcidiopsis* and related extremophilic cyanobacterial lineages.

[View project](projects/chroococcidiopsales-ecogenomics/)

### Comparative Genomics and Functional Characterization of *Lactiplantibacillus plantarum* E2C2

Independent bioinformatics project focused on the genomic characterization of a lactic acid bacterium relevant to food biotechnology and probiotic applications.

The project includes raw-read quality control, preprocessing, taxonomic assessment, de novo assembly, genome-quality evaluation, annotation, safety and functional screening, and comparative genomics within a reproducible Snakemake workflow.

[View full project →](projects/sacco-lab/index.qmd)
